run_test_suites: run specific test suites and cases using the component test framework with argparse CLI
run_tests_with_repeat: run test cases multiple times with configurable repeat count and break time between rounds
run_tests_shuffle: run test cases in shuffled order across all suites using the shuffle_all flag
run_tests_debug: run test cases in debug mode waiting for user to attach a debugger to the process
run_tests_skip_proc: run test cases without starting the test process for eclipse debug purposes
